source_review_identity_evidence.body_identity: Exhortation to Catholic clergy for the fiftieth year of the pope’s priesthood; opening on Hebrews 13:17 and account for souls; priestly holiness, prayer and meditation, spiritual reading, examination of conscience, retreats and priestly associations; closing petition and Marian commendation.
source_review_identity_evidence.date: Closing expressly gives fourth day of August, beginning the sixth pontifical year. OCR of the Roman-numeral year is MCMVHL.; retain it rather than silently correcting. Printed annual title establishes 1908, and the fiftieth priesthood year/body identify the 4 August 1908 act.
